items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, Hassan, Max did a trio record with him.

ctx.x: We had a guy in Philly, when they talk about Cecil, Hassan.
Oh, Hassan, Max did a trio record with him.
Yes, he used to come to our house all the time. Eight o'clock in the morning and he would stay until my father got home from work and then we would leave and he would just be up in bed.
